intro: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has Officially Released Pre Admit Card for the Post of Auditor under Panchayati Raj Dept., Govt. Of Bihar. Additionally, individuals holding degrees such as MBA (Finance), CA, ICWA, or CS are also eligible to apply for this position.
For More Details, Read Official Notification.
Pay Scale: Rs.5200-20200/- Rs.2800 Grade Pay (Level-5)
Selection Process:Selection on the Basis of Pre Exam/ Written Exam & Interview.
Subject: General Studies, consisting of objective-type multiple-choice questions.
Duration & Marks: The exam will last 2 hours and carry a total of 150 marks.

																	SC/ST, Women, and Disabled candidates: 32%
Note: General Hindi is a qualifying subject requiring a minimum of 30 marks, but these marks will not be counted toward the final merit list.
Syllabus: The syllabus for all subjects is the same as the Combined Competitive Examination and is available at www.bpsc.bih.ar.gov.in.
Candidate Selection: The number of candidates called for the interview will be approximately $2 \frac{1}{2}$ times the number of vacancies based on written exam scores.
Final Merit List: The final merit list will be prepared based on the combined marks of the Written Examination and the Interview.

Tie-Breaking: In case of a tie in total marks, the candidate with higher marks in the written exam will be ranked higher. If those are also equal, seniority in age will be considered, followed by alphabetical order in the Devanagari script.
Revaluation: There is no provision for revaluation in this recruitment process.
26 February 2026: Last date for registration and fee payment.
